attribution: Contains information from the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database, made available under the ODC Attribution License v1.0. Collected by Michael Oeff at University Clinic Benjamin Franklin, Berlin; provided by PTB through PhysioNet.
citations: Bousseljot R, Kreiseler D, Schnabel A. Nutzung der EKG-Signaldatenbank CARDIODAT der PTB ueber das Internet. Biomedizinische Technik 40, Ergaenzungsband 1 (1995), 317.
Pollard T et al. PhysioNet as a global platform for biomedical research. Nature Health (2026). doi:10.1038/s44360-026-00096-z.
selection: First listed recording from each of the first three subject directories in PhysioNet RECORDS; samples [0, 8000), 12 standard leads. A convenience subset, not a representative cohort.
processing: Lossless extraction of signed 16-bit counts. No resampling, centering, denoising or normalisation. Clinical header comments are omitted.
